summary: W5a's own done-list parts are met when re-measured: 0 structures within collision radius + 3 m of a thicket on RIFT and BRIDGE, probe_maps 102/102, Art 2.0 landmarks with painted stone, ink joints and chalk edges in fresh shot_map re-shoots, spawn out-of-bounds at L* p50 12-24 with p95 <= 29, and Longshade has no tears with the ruling recorded. value_probe RIFT High walkableSpread is red (49 vs 45, and 47 even with the old fight spot pinned), but an A/B with all 53 model landmarks hidden reads the same p5, and RIFT content has changed only in plazaAubade and landmarks since the 44-PASS pinned run, so the cause is outside W5a. The wave fails on one W5a regression found while measuring. The new off-map skirts add 90-230k triangles at every map edge, about 73k of it in the shadow pass at the south edge. A RIFT low-road fight (101.5, 95.6; t 900; seed 7; High) measures 570k triangles with the skirts and 473k without, against the 500k hard budget. perf_1080 --prod still passes (483k High, 421k Low) only because its fight spot that run was mid-map. Minors: Wick hood RIFT Low 67.1 (cap 65; the claimed 65.9 does not reproduce), F5 not done, the HUD-3 art half is done, the VI slab and numerals are still SDF primitives, and the camp clusters are tiny primitives.

items.evidence:
Point-in-polygon, my own script (_harness/_reports/fw_W5a_ver1_pip.py, result in fw_W5a_ver1_pip.txt; radii from content/units.json):
- RIFT: 24 structures, 0 within r + 3 m of any thicket; worst margin +0.19 m (seat Outer Needles to thickets 12/13).
- BRIDGE: 0 within r + 3 m; worst margin +0.26 m.

probe_maps.ts: 102/102 PASS (_harness/_reports/fw_W5a_ver1_probe_maps.log).

value_probe (fw_W5a_ver1_value_probe.log): every gate passes on RIFT Low, BRIDGE High/Low and FRAY High/Low. RIFT High walkableSpread FAILs at 49 (<= 45). Attribution, measured:
- Every non-fight spot matches the final_maps baseline per spot (frameP50/laneP50 identical).
- b.fight() now returns (85.6, 55.2), which duplicates the 'centre' spot. The baseline fight spot was (89.1, 96.4).
- With the fight spot pinned to (89.1, 96.4) (scratch copy, fw_W5a_ver1_value_probe_pinned.mjs/.log) it reads 47, not the 44 claimed: walkable p5 54 vs 57 in W5a's own 15:11 pinned run.
- The same pinned run with all 53 model landmarks hidden (skirts, camp lips, new landmarks) gives an identical walkable p5 54 / lane 63 / seat 42 and spread 47 (fw_W5a_ver1_value_probe_pinned_nolm.log).
- content/maps/map_rift.json has changed only in plazaAubade and landmarks since dd90e85a (14:31). Plaza pixels are not in any RIFT spot, so the 57 -> 54 drop comes from other lanes' render or sim changes.

W5a's part of the criterion holds; the red gate is listed under regressions for W1/W4.

Fresh shot_map --nofog re-shoots at the final_maps_vfy edge spots: _harness/_shots/fw_W5a_ver1_rift_edge_at0-6, fw_W5a_ver1_bridge_edge_at0-1, fw_W5a_ver1_bridge_edge2_at0-1, fw_W5a_ver1_fray_edge_at0-3, and pans fw_W5a_ver1_rift_pan_at0-3 and fw_W5a_ver1_bridge_pan_at0-2.
- Shaft drum (rift_edge_at2): coursed octagonal drums, dark hour-bands with lugs, iron cramp, ink joints, chalked rims.
- Snap stubs (bridge_edge2_at1): the same treatment.
- Noon stone (rift_edge_at4): chalk drums, a sunk XII panel, chalk arrises.
- Shadow slabs (rift_edge_at5): basalt courses with a lit chalk coping and beaded arrises; no longer a black box.
- Belfry (rift_pan_at0): coursed chalk blocks, stepped buttresses.
- Lamp Dome (rift_pan_at1).
- Dawn Arch: W1's 4 m camera clamp inset (camera.ts, 3ce55f62 17:15) now keeps it almost entirely out of frame; only its glass infill shows at the top-left of bridge_pan_at0. Verified instead on the Art 2.0 render art/renders/maps/landmarks_art2_dawn_arch.png and the pre-inset in-game shot fw_W5a_lm3_vfy_bridge_edge_at3.png (chalk voussoirs, ink joints, steel strap).

Minor: the raw fracture ends of the drum and stubs are pinched radial facets.

Spawn views, out-of-bounds masked beyond the boundary wall's lip (_harness/_reports/fw_W5a_ver1_lstar.py):
- RIFT Aubade (fw_W5a_ver1_rift_edge_at0): L* p50 12.3, p95 29.0, 0 % above 52 (moss strip, Belfry court).
- RIFT Serenade (rift_edge_at1): p50 17.7, p95 28.2.
- BRIDGE Aubade (fw_W5a_ver1_bridge_edge3_at0): p50 15.7, p95 28.0, the skirt_court flags.
- BRIDGE Serenade (bridge_edge2_at0): p50 24.2, p95 28.9.

No bare plane at any spawn. One caveat: in the first BRIDGE run (fw_W5a_ver1_bridge_edge_at0) the 355 KB skirt_court GLBs had not finished loading after shot_map's 5 s settle on the loaded machine, so the old purple terrace showed. They were present in the re-run, so it is a pop-in risk only.

FRAY seat IX court: p50 35.8, p95 52.8 (6.8 % above 52). That is the brief's haze court, not a skirt.

As done:1: 0 violations, worst +0.19 m.

Visual (_harness/_shots/value_rift_high_fw_W5a_ver1_lane0.png vs final_maps_value/value_rift_high_final_maps_lane0.png): the Outer Needle stands on open road; the curbed grass ring at its foot is gone.

The structure_keep_out() and camp_lips() code is present in _design/tools/map_gen.py:237,266,555,704. Not measured: a regeneration to confirm map_gen output equals content/maps, because shapely is not installed in any local Python.
See done:6. The tears are removed, the ruling is recorded, and the icon was re-rendered.

Fix step 1 (Art 2.0 landmarks): verified, see done:2.

Fix step 2 (dressed skirt at L* <= 52): verified at the spawns (done:3), at the edge pans (rift_pan_at2/at3, bridge_pan_at2) and at the corners (fw_W5a_ver1_{rift,bridge,fray}_corner_at*):
- RIFT corner out-of-bounds L* p50 20-23, p95 <= 43.
- Small flat green residual strips remain at the extreme RIFT corners beyond the skirt grid (rift_corner_at2/at3), a minor.

Fix step 3 (a dais in place of the spawn ring) was not built; it was handed to W1 because the ring is a terrain.ts inlay. Minor; not in the done-list.

The skirts cost triangles: see regression item perf:skirt-tris.

Script: _harness/_reports/fw_W5a_ver1_edgecount.mjs, real Chrome GPU, dev server, renderer.profile() totals, every pass. It compares the 40 skirt and camp-lip landmarks shown vs hidden at the same frame.

RIFT High (fw_W5a_ver1_edge_counts_rift2.log):
- Low-road fight at (101.5, 95.6), t 900, seed 7: 569,907 triangles vs 473,243 hidden. Over the 500k hard budget only because of the skirts (landmarks 97k tris, 10 draws).
- South edge (85, 110): 465k vs 309k.
- NW corner: 364k vs 117k (landmark tris 264k).
- SW corner: 270k vs 83k.

Run 3 (fw_W5a_ver1_edge_counts_rift3.log): at the south edge the skirts alone are 49k tris in 5 main draws plus 73k in 7 shadow draws, at both High and Low.

The official perf_1080 --prod run passed (fw_W5a_ver1_perf_1080.json: High 483k, 60 fps, p99 16.8; Low 421k; GATE PASS), but its fight spot that run had landmarks at 0k. The south (camera-side) skirt is in frame for any low-road fight.

items.evidence: I looked at every new or changed render and in-game shot: Longshade icon and sheet, greatwick Serenade, the 10 landmarks_art2_*.png, the 5 camp clusters, the 6 skirt renders, and the in-game edge, pan, corner and camp shots. No tall, pointed or conical hoods. No horror, hockey or blank-mannequin face. No Wick with an eye pair or a mouth. The Belfry spire and booth roofs are architecture. Longshade keeps lamp eyes on a creature, which the ruling allows. The Hooded Lamp ward's rounded knob (owner ruling §5) is not yet done; owner_rulings.md assigns it to unit art or the integration pass.

The VI slab (85, 107, on the camera-side south rim) still reads as a soft SDF pillow with carved VI next to Art 2.0 work (fw_W5a_ver1_rift_pan_at3), and the 4 numerals remain landmarks.py SDF builds. The F1 list did not name them, but they sit at the same zoom. glass_belfry.glb is 1.74 MB / 34.8k tris, the largest landmark.
items.fixHint: Optional: rebuild vi_slab and the numerals through landmarks_art2.py's structure_kit bake. Drop the Belfry's flag chamfers if the build budget needs it.

regressions: W5a, major: the off-map skirts push a RIFT low-road fight frame to 569,907 triangles at High (473,243 with skirts and camp lips hidden), over the 500k hard budget. Edge views gain 90-230k triangles, 73k of it in the shadow pass at the south edge (_harness/_reports/fw_W5a_ver1_edge_counts_rift2.log, rift3.log). perf_1080 --prod itself PASSES (fw_W5a_ver1_perf_1080.json) because its fight spot that run was mid-map.

Out of lane (W1/W4), not caused by W5a: value_probe RIFT High walkableSpread 49 FAIL (<= 45).
- Cause 1: b.fight() now picks (85.6, 55.2), a duplicate of 'centre'.
- Cause 2: with the old spot pinned it still reads 47, because walkable p5 fell 57 -> 54 from render or sim changes in other lanes.
- Proof: hiding all 53 model landmarks changes nothing (fw_W5a_ver1_value_probe_pinned_nolm.log), and RIFT content changed only in plazaAubade and landmarks since the 44-PASS run.
- Fix for W1: pin one fight spot per map or leave 'fight' out of the walkable pool, then find the lane p5 drop.

Out of lane (W4, mid-edit): npm run probe has 46 passed and 1 failed. probe_sim_structures 'sudden death: no structure is protected' FAILs (_harness/_reports/fw_W5a_ver1_probe.log). It is a sim structure-protection rule, not map geometry.

Out of lane (W1 harness): the :5190 dev server serves a stale _harness/web/render_bench.ts without profile() or timing(), because vite.config.ts UNWATCHED includes _harness. Dev-mode bench scripts that call b.profile() fail until the server restarts; --prod is unaffected.
